record.reason: The study analyzes a large OpenRouter token dataset and empirical model usage patterns, with results about workload/model mix. It provides context for memory-aware placement and scheduling but does not propose or evaluate a serving optimization itself; request population and telemetry coverage bound generalization.
record.title: State of AI: An Empirical 100 Trillion Token Study with OpenRouter
